summary: Make every ordinary user-facing EKODI site public by default, redefine FREE signup as additional benefits rather than access permission, and let each site administrator configure FREE and paid benefits/packages within immutable security guardrails.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed a full-site audit, constitutional recording, implementation, and site-local administration of free and paid membership benefits.
migrationPlan: Replace FREE-as-content-gate policy with public-by-default access, preserve authentication for private/admin/security-sensitive state, add site-local benefit configuration, then audit all registered user services and workspace public routes for regressions.
securityModel: Public content requires no membership. Personal state, private workspace data, billing, mutations and administrator controls remain authenticated and capability-authorized. Site admins can configure benefits but cannot disable the public-content invariant.
rollback: Revert the v1.9.1 amendment and benefit configuration runtime while preserving existing private/admin authorization boundaries and stored benefit profiles for later recovery.
verificationPolicy: Constitution validation, universal membership validation, workspace-admin authorization tests, public-access audit, build/check, guarded merge, deployment and production public-host probes must pass.
